title: Mori / Quiet companion
name: 安静的陪伴者
idea: Closest to the reference but significantly more refined. A single deep-evergreen lowercase-m-like creature, two gentle domed shoulders and three very short rounded feet, compact wider-than-tall body, two ivory vertical capsule eyes with slightly asymmetric attentive gaze. Make this silhouette subtly animal-like, intelligent and alive, not a ghost, elephant, or mere letter with eyes. No mouth, ears, antenna, limbs stuck on, accessories or decoration. Refined fluid curves with controlled narrow valleys; proportion of overall body width to height approximately 1.618, circle-derived curvature. Personality: observant, quietly devoted, remembers everything. Show expression changes through eyelids, gaze and modest body squash.
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a premium brand-and-character concept board for Mory, a personal AI memory operating system. Original character design, do not imitate any existing AI brand, robot, game mascot or pet. Warm ivory background, deep forest green #103F31 primary, butter yellow #F5D873 sparingly. Clean precise edges, no gradients, no grain, no 3D, no mockups, no drop shadows. Design with golden-ratio-inspired proportions and optically harmonious circular curves; do not fabricate precision claims or draw decorative Fibonacci spirals. Square high-resolution board. Bottom 30% contains a coherent strip of FIVE small instances of EXACT SAME mascot showing IDLE, CURIOUS, THINKING, HAPPY, SLEEPING with slight pose and gaze changes; vary expression and movement, never redesign anatomy. In upper right a small rounded-square app icon shows same hero simplified, with ample clear space. Small unobtrusive concept ID/title in top left. Text limited to concept ID/title, 'mory', and five state labels. The main neutral logo MUST stay simple and readable at 24 pixels. title: Mimo / Memory pet
name: 记忆小宠物
idea: An original abstract baby memory-animal, not a known species. Evergreen squat soft body with TWO short ear-like rounded upper humps echoing the letter m, two tiny ivory eyes held in generous negative space, two subtle integrated feet, and ONE short curved tail with a round butter-yellow tip like a stored memory. The tail must feel anatomically integrated and optional for tiny icon reduction. No mouth, nose, paws, furry texture or kawaii ornament. Silhouette is instantly recognizable and geometrically restrained. Body-to-face proportions guided by 1.618 nested masses. Personality: curious, follows your cursor, curls up when sleeping. Pet state illustrations must preserve exact anatomy.

title: Memo / Living bot
name: 有生命的 Bot
idea: Original next-generation AI bot mascot. An extremely minimal pebble-shaped evergreen bot with an integrated shallow M-shaped notch at the top and a SINGLE ivory pill-shaped visor aperture containing two tiny evergreen expressive pupils. Rounded body integrated with two tiny rounded supports; NO antenna, headphones, segmented robot joints, human hands, floating sparkles, or screen outline. One restrained butter-yellow status dot integrated into lower right body. Golden ratio approximately 1.618 governs body's width to height and visor width to body width approximately .618. Personality: capable, attentive, gently mischievous. Make it iconic even without facial details. Contemporary independent software studio identity.

title: Moru / Folded familiar
name: 折叠记忆精灵
idea: A highly distinctive abstract memory familiar built from ONE continuous soft folded m-shaped ribbon-body, with rounded twin crest, a subtle inward fold that creates protected negative space, two inset ivory capsule eyes, and tiny integrated rounded feet. Evergreen solid color with only one lighter green plane to clarify the fold, no gradients. The shape should read as a living little being first, a letter second. No wings, horns, ears, antenna, mouth, accessories. Circle-derived construction with approximate 1:1.618 mass relationships and generous optical correction. Personality: calm, protective of your memories, sleepy when idle, perky when discovering a connection.
